content: Letter 30, to Amīr Sayyid Nāṣir Kārkiyā (ca. 831-32/1428-29, Gilan): a congratulatory letter on Sayyid Nāṣir's conquest, as communicated by members of his court near Rayy and discussed in a recent majlis; Ibn Turka praises the amir's patronage of scholars and regrets he cannot attend the court because of physical infirmity (TMN/MS pp. 24-25, TMN/D pp. 196-99).
